anti_overfitting: event KXCPI-26SEP is the only target; no substitution after protocol freeze
include the complete qualifying sibling set; no hand-selected thresholds
market observation time/selection rule cannot change after seeing Reuters or BLS truth
Reuters source/admission/corroboration rules cannot change per candidate
no Reuters probability transform is permitted
no fees, PnL, sizing, slippage, fills, queue position, or execution simulation in this gate
one supportive event cannot establish durable edge or production readiness

decision_gate.INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT: Reuters evidence is not PASS, first-party preflight fails, market evidence is incomplete, truth authority is unavailable, or fewer than 4 common eligible siblings remain
decision_gate.PROSPECTIVE_CONTRADICTION: Reuters primary correct count is strictly less than Kalshi on at least 4 common eligible siblings
decision_gate.PROSPECTIVE_SUPPORT_DIAGNOSTIC: Reuters primary correct count is strictly greater than Kalshi on at least 4 common eligible siblings
decision_gate.PROSPECTIVE_TIE_NO_ADVANTAGE: Reuters and Kalshi primary correct counts are equal on at least 4 common eligible siblings
decision_gate.support_next_action: freeze a multi-event prospective extension before the next CPI event

market_observation.bounded_retry_rule: up to 3 acquisition attempts inside the fixed window; no attempts after 12:20Z
market_observation.missing_quote_rule: missing or boundary yes_ask is excluded for both sources on that sibling; never impute, interpolate, use last trade, or substitute midpoint
market_observation.selection_rule: for each sibling select the unique latest 60-minute candle whose end_period_ts is strictly before that sibling market close

requirements: BLS still identifies September 2026 CPI for 2026-10-14 08:30 ET
Kalshi event identity is exactly KXCPI-26SEP in series KXCPI
the complete event contains exactly 14 sibling markets
every admitted sibling is active/open, simple binary, non-provisional, non-MVE
every admitted sibling resolves strict-GT headline CPI month-over-month for 2026-09
any mismatch fails closed before Reuters evidence or scoring is used

pass_requirements: article body/dateline explicitly identifies reference month 2026-09
specific headline CPI month-over-month forecast is stated prospectively
value is preserved as exact Decimal at published precision
governing publication time is positively evidenced and precedes each scored sibling close
at least 2 independently operated hosts carry the same Reuters wire revision
search_rungs: approved syndicated Reuters hosts using exact release-date and day-before queries
Wayback/CDX retrieval over the same approved host set

scoring.aggregation_rule: mean directional correctness across eligible siblings within the single event
scoring.common_denominator_rule: both Reuters and Kalshi are scored only on the same eligible siblings
scoring.kalshi_call: YES iff yes_ask > 0.5; NO iff yes_ask < 0.5; exact 0.5 is TIE
scoring.reuters_call: YES iff Reuters forecast > sibling threshold; otherwise NO
scoring.tie_rule: Kalshi exact-0.5 sibling is excluded from the common primary denominator
scoring.truth_authority: BLS initial release only; no later revision
scoring.truth_call: YES iff BLS initial-release headline CPI MoM > sibling threshold; otherwise NO
